forms.title: Lever hosted application (jobs.lever.co/<company>/<uuid>/apply)
quirks: single Full name field (name) instead of first/last
resume: transparent file input over an ATTACH RESUME/CV button inside a <label>, Analyzing resume... then Success! with the filename
location typeahead (#location-input) filling hidden selectedLocation JSON only when a suggestion is picked
posting card cards[<uuid>][fieldN] with hidden baseTemplate JSON: radio multiple-choice, native dropdown, textarea
pronoun checkboxes with Custom text field
Additional information textarea (comments) as the cover-letter slot
consent checkboxes with hidden 0 companions (consent[store] required, consent[marketing] opt-in)
invisible hCaptcha (data-size=invisible) executed on submit, never a visible challenge; token not required by the server
button#btn-submit type=button triggers hidden submit button: native constraint validation, classic multipart POST, 303 to /thanks
forms.reference: Public jobs.lever.co/<company>/<uuid>/apply pages (spotify, palantir): server-rendered form markup, card JSON, consent section and the hCaptcha submit script
